description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Use when an agent asks who the most profitable crypto traders are or wants smart-money wallets to track/copy. Ranked from public Hyperliquid chain data (~47k accounts): address, PnL, ROI, volume, account value. Returns a JSON ranking of Hyperliquid wallets with address, PnL, ROI, volume, and account value.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

limit.description: Maximum wallets. Format: positive integer. Example: 10. The tool text caps the list at 200.

min_account.description: Optional minimum account value in USD. Format: a number. Example: 10000. Omit for no extra minimum.

sort.description: Sort key. Format: one of the values already in the tool text: pnl, roi, volume, worst. Example: pnl. Omit for the server's current sort.

venue.description: Venue slug. Format: a lowercase venue id. Example: hyperliquid. The tool text describes the Hyperliquid leaderboard. Omit for the server's current venue.

window.description: Ranking window. Format: one of the values already in the tool text: day, week, month, allTime. Example: week. Omit for the server's current window.

name: top_traders
title: Top Hyperliquid traders by PnL/ROI ($0.005)
